title: Warm Flaky Argentinian Peach Empanadas
description: A crowd-pleasing Argentinian dessert featuring peaches in a flaky pastry, cooked to perfection in a bamboo steamer. This egg-free friendly dish is perfect for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat the bamboo steamer by filling it with boiling water and letting it steam for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, and salt to make the empanada dough.
Add melted butter and water to the dough mixture and knead until a smooth dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a spoonful of diced peaches in the center of each circle, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the dough over the peaches to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas in the preheated bamboo steamer, leaving some space between each empanada.
Steam the empanadas for 12 minutes, or until the pastry is cooked through and the peaches are tender.
Serve the empanadas warm, garnished with powdered sugar if desired.
